name: horizon-e2e
description: Playwright suite driving the real Horizon server + built UI in demo mode (no GitHub, mock agents, temp DB). Run via `npm run test:e2e` at the repo root.

scripts.test: bash ../scripts/node-test-report.sh e2e-unit fixtures/test-base.test.mjs ports.test.mjs jsonl-reporter.test.mjs && bash ../scripts/node-test-report.sh e2e-smoke-check smoke/check.test.mjs && playwright test
